Step 1: 43 weeks = 43 × 7 = 301 days.  
Step 2: 301 days + 3 days = 304 days to add.  
Step 3: 1570 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1570 not divisible by 4).  
Step 4: Add 304 days to 1570-04-15:  
From 1570-04-15 to 1570-12-31 = 260 days (16+31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31).  
304 − 260 = 44 days into 1571.  
1571-01-01 + 44 days = 1571-02-14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1571-02-14
